notes.title: BL00D.exe Demo Patch 3
notes.notes:
So after hearing some constructive criticism from a few people, I've decided to remove a feature from the game. Let me know what y'all think, and enjoy the update! Cheers!

- Removed "glitch crouch hopping"
- Added infinite sliding
- Fixed collision for light beams

notes.title: BL00D.exe Day Two Patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, thanks for playing the demo yesterday and dealing with all the goofy bugs I left in before releasing. I fixed most of them, but feel free to let me know if I missed any with the in game SHARE FEEDBACK button.

Today I tweaked a few things and fixed a few small bugs. I also update the speed lines and fov change to occur based off speed, instead of Sprint Input Action. I also made a slight adjustment to the Cyberspace Neural Calibration Course respawn, due to some unfair restarts.

Stay tuned for more updates, we should be having a big update for the demo within the next month or two!

Thanks for playing,

Aidan @ IMIGE

notes.title: BL00D.exe Final Day One Hot Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed a plethora of small bugs found most notably,

- Included .mp4 files with game packaging
- Fixed white crosshair bug
- Added an invisible wall to Cyberspace Level 1
- A few more small bugs

notes.title: BL00D.exe Demo Hot Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed some UI Bugs
Made "Escape" open the Pause Menu (this was disabled due to Unreal Test Builds)
Added a "Share Your Feedback" button to the Main Menu
Added some UI to the Demo Subsistence Levels
Save Game fixed for Demo Complete and Subsistence Enabled

notes.title: Delayed Demo Apology
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I just wanted to apologize for the delayed launch of the demo. I'm new to publishing games on Steam, and I didn't know that there was a processing delay for the demo. I'm sure it'll be available shortly though!

I'm super excited for all of you to test it out, and to share your feedback. I plan to update the demo later in January or February to include the 2nd level and hopefully some more unique Subsistence levels, so stay tuned for that. 

Take Care, and Happy Holidays,

- Aidan, Lead Developer @ IMIGE
